title: fix(platform-objects,plugin-audit,plugin-approvals)!: mail bodies are read only with manage_platform_settings, and the audit mirrors never copy them in clear
body:
Closes #24625
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Dispatched by the epic seat (`epic:#15194`) under claim 6278944518, on the maintainer's order. Measured record: 6278938192.

## The defect, re-measured on `main` `bfc1539fe`

The test this PR adds was run on unchanged `main`, over #24552's 18.0 fixture under `single`. The fixture holds one 18.0 password-reset row and one organization-invitation row in `sys_email`. Result: 9 red, 11 green, matching the seat's matrix. The 9 red were:

- An organization administrator without `manage_platform_settings` was served `body_text` and `body_html` of the 18.0 reset row on `/data` list, get and query.
- Global search found the reset row by a term from its body, for that same administrator.
- The `sys_activity` and `sys_audit_log` mirrors of the reset row served the body to that administrator.
- On HEAD, the mirror rows written for a new `sys_identity_email` row held its body in clear at rest. So did the mirror rows for a new `sys_email` row.

Anonymous (401), member (403, no search hit), and the identity log for both non-platform principals (403) were already closed.

## The fix, and why this one

**The selector question first.** No column tells an 18.0 identity row in `sys_email` apart from tenant mail:

- A magic link carries no `related_object`, and `sys_email` has no template column.
- Notification mail (`service-messaging`'s email channel) also carries no `related_object`.

So a row gate of "related to `sys_user` or to nothing" would hide every notification from the organization administrator. Per the dispatch, with no reliable selector the fix is field-level.

1. **Read gate (platform-objects).** `body_text` and `body_html` on `sys_email` and `sys_identity_email` declare `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']` (ADR-0066 D3). This one declaration closes every door that serves rows through the engine:
   - `/data` list, get and query (the key is dropped, `?select=` included). A body predicate is refused with 403.
   - Export.
   - Global search, which matches only on queryable fields.
   - The `sys_activity` / `sys_audit_log` read redaction, which serves a mirror the fields the data plane serves. The #21154 value-column guard also refuses that administrator's body probes on the mirrors, pinned or not.

   The administrator keeps every row: envelope, subject, delivery state and linkage. They lose only the bodies.
2. **Mirror writers (plugin-audit).** The ledger view masks both logs' body columns on every row, the way it masks a credential field. A non-empty body is stored as the read mask and an unset one stays `null`. This covers the create, update and delete snapshots and the activity row. The two names live once, in `platform-objects/src/audit/mail-log-body.ts`.
3. **A shipped defect this change would have triggered (plugin-approvals).** `sys_approval_request` free-text search auto-included `payload_json`. The snapshot guard refuses any query naming that column to a reader withheld any field of any object. Once mail bodies are withheld from the organization administrator, that administrator's **whole global search sweep returned 403** (measured on this branch before the fix). Their approvals list search would also have failed. The object now declares `searchableFields` = the ADR-0061 auto-default minus `payload_json`. A test holds the declared list to that derivation. A structured filter on the snapshot is unchanged for the readers the guard admits.

**What is not changed.**
- The platform administrator reads every body.
- The mail pipeline reads as the system and is not narrowed.
- Rows and mirror copies already at rest keep what they stored. They are served only to readers who are served the body. Rewriting them belongs to the 18.x ceremony (#24581), not here.

## Tests: principal × door

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/identity-mail-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts` runs over the 18.0 fixture: 22 cases. Every probe is a link-token span read as the system and compared by inclusion, so no value appears in a title, message or log.

| principal | `/data` list / get / query | body filter | global search | `sys_activity` / `sys_audit_log` | `sys_identity_email` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| anonymous | 401 | — | — | — | — |
| member | 403 | — | no hit | no body | 403 |
| organization admin | rows served (identity row **and** its own invitation), no body | 403 | 200, no hit | rows served, no body; body probe 403 | 403 |
| platform admin (control) | bodies served | 200, one row | hit | 18.0 copy served | 200 with body |

The writers are pinned too: the mirror rows of a HEAD-written `sys_identity_email` row and of a HEAD-written `sys_email` row hold no body at rest. Unit tests:
- `platform-objects/src/audit/mail-log-body.test.ts`: the declaration, with no object-level gate on `sys_email`.
- `plugin-audit/src/audit-internal-field-omission.test.ts`: the mask on every snapshot side, null preserved, and a non-mail-log control.
- `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.search-fields.test.ts`.

**Reverse verification.** Each leg used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then a rebuild of the package, then `ablation-dist-preflight` (marker present, then absent after restore). Each leg was restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **A1:** body `requiredPermissions` removed from `sys_email` → 8 dogfood red: the organization-admin list, get, query, search and both mirror reads and both mirror probes.
- **A2:** ledger mask disabled → 4 plugin-audit unit red and 2 dogfood writer red. The preflight exit code on this leg was read through a pipe, so it is void. The dist reach is shown by the dogfood red instead.
- **A3:** `payload_json` put back into the approvals search set → 1 unit red and the organization-admin global search red.

## Proof (head `e7f2dd039`)

- **R1:** `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38625` boots the showcase. The seeded admin signs in, and `/data/sys_email`, `/data/sys_identity_email`, `/data/showcase_task` and `/search` answer 200. A password-reset request answers 200. The log has no error lines. The server was stopped and the port is free.
- **R2:** `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` is green. It ran together with the new matrix, `search-skip-unreadable`, `audit-log-admin-search`, `activity-text-predicate` and `signup-organization-census`: 6 files, 62 passed.
- **R3:** the harness's v17 case is still refused at boot (same run).
- **R4:** `packages/cli` `serve-walled-posture-refusal.test.ts` (integration project): 5 passed.
- **Packages:**
  - Typecheck exit 0 for platform-objects, plugin-audit, plugin-approvals, plugin-email and dogfood.
  - vitest: platform-objects 1196 passed, plugin-audit 935, plugin-approvals 1140, plugin-email 571.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 74 commands, and all 74 exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
  - Two commands first exited 3 on environment prerequisites. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed a full build. Both were re-run green after the fix.
- `check-governed-merges --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 531 changed lines.

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope beyond the claimed surface:** `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` (fix 3). It is the shipped defect this change would otherwise trigger for every organization administrator. Without it, the narrowing ships a global-search outage.
- **Behaviour an operator will see:**
  - An organization administrator no longer sees any mail body, including the organization's own notification and invitation bodies. They still see that each message was sent, to whom and with what result.
  - An unpinned value-column query on `sys_activity` / `sys_audit_log` is now refused to them, as the #21154 guard does for any reader withheld a field. Those copies hold 18.0 identity bodies at rest, so this is the oracle closing, not a regression.
  - Free-text search on approval requests no longer matches inside the JSON snapshot, for any reader.
- **Not done here:** mirror rows written before this release still hold bodies at rest. They are served only to readers who are served the body. The ceremony owns moving the identity rows (#24581).
- **Released line:** `@objectstack/plugin-email@17.3.0` has the same exposure. The backport to `release/17.x` is owed when that branch is cut (seat record 6278938192).
